title: Unique Garlicky Croatian Seafood Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian dish featuring a mix of frozen seafood, this garlicky pilaf is perfect for a hangover cure or a satisfying meal, and is also shojin-friendly as it does not contain any animal products except for the seafood.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the thawed seafood mix, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to combine with the seafood mixture.
Add the water and lemon juice, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf sit, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
